More or less ok
Dec 2025 • Solo
We went to Sushi Ngu in Phu Quoc for lunch and found it to be a solid, no-frills option. Nothing fancy and nothing particularly special, but the food was correct, reasonably fresh, and fairly priced. Portions were decent, service was straightforward, and overall it delivered exactly what you’d expect at this level. A reliable 4/5 place if you’re looking for simple sushi at good prices without high expectations.
